notes: μή and πως are separate units because the ASV writes two English expressions for them, lest and by any means; rule 39 is scoped to a cluster rendered by a single word and rule 94 makes the count of English words the test.

The head of by any means is the one open choice here: means carries the manner sense that distinguishes the lexeme, while rule 69's any man precedent would point to any. The unit note names the competing reading.
The article before ἐξουσία is unrepresented because the attributive demonstrative αὕτη already fills the English determiner slot (rule 38).
τοῖς takes the English the with its case preposition riding along and the substantival ἀσθενέσιν stands bare (rules 21, 58).
v010 is underdetermined with the projection on r00-base, which the English permits; no textual decision is taken here (rule 12).
